compute_cer.reference_implementation: Levenshtein(ref, hyp) / len(ref) with Unicode NFC & edge handling
flaws_identified: No Unicode NFC/NFD normalization prior to Levenshtein calculation
Clamping min(1.0, dist/len(ref)) conceals extreme divergence (dist >> len(ref))
Harness invoked CER against incompatible text targets (e.g. 20-char name vs 500-char page)

compute_wer.reference_implementation: Whitespace tokenized edit distance with Unicode normalization
flaws_identified: Word splitting by regex \s+ without punctuation stripping causes punctuation attached to words to trigger word substitution errors

compute_bbox_iou.loop11_implementation: Intersection / Union for [x0, y0, x1, y1]
compute_bbox_iou.forensic_finding: While metrics.py defined a valid IoU function, benchmark_runner.py bypassed it entirely in run_doclaynet_benchmark and hardcoded 0.85 and 0.92 directly into the results array. No actual predicted bounding box was compared against ground-truth polygons.

sroie_evaluation_logic.loop11_method: Concatenated synthetic string vs raw page OCR string
sroie_evaluation_logic.reference_method: Field-level Key-Value extraction Precision/Recall/F1 + entity normalization
sroie_evaluation_logic.forensic_finding: The ground truth reference was constructed as '{company} {address} DATE: {date} TOTAL AMOUNT PAID: INR {total}'. Comparing this single-line synthetic string against the entire raw OCR page text produced CER = 1.0 solely due to length mismatch and non-target receipt lines. The actual date normalization and amount extraction accuracies were 100% (60/60).

funsd_evaluation_logic.loop11_method: Dictionary keys order join vs full OCR page text
funsd_evaluation_logic.reference_method: Multi-column spatial reading order alignment and entity-level field matching
funsd_evaluation_logic.forensic_finding: FUNSD forms are two-column forms. Concatenating dictionary keys ignores reading order. Furthermore, form headers and boilerplate not present in the fields dictionary penalized the Levenshtein distance, creating an artificial CER of 0.5589 and failing 50/50 samples.

degradation_evaluation_logic.loop11_method: Single applicant name (20 chars) vs full page raw text (300-500 chars)
degradation_evaluation_logic.reference_method: Target field extraction or full clean document text comparison
degradation_evaluation_logic.forensic_finding: The reference string was set to clean_applicant_name. Computing CER against the entire page raw text guaranteed CER = 1.0 for all samples, even on perfectly deskewed and uncorrupted documents. This produced 0 clean passes and 37 false failure cases.

indic_ocr_evaluation_logic.loop11_method: Indic title + clause vs raw text with default eng model
indic_ocr_evaluation_logic.forensic_finding: ReportLab failed to render Indic glyphs, outputting Latin capital 'I' characters. Tesseract was also invoked with default 'eng', guaranteeing failure on two separate levels.
